paragraphs: The 330e has been part of the 3 Series range since 2019, using the B48 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine paired with an electric motor in a plug-in hybrid configuration. It's fitted to the G20 saloon and G21 Touring generations. The B48 is a well-regarded engine family in its own right — it's the same base unit used across a wide range of BMW models of this era, with the hybrid system integrated alongside it. As a PHEV, the 330e combines the B48's familiar characteristics with electric assistance for improved efficiency and lower emissions, without compromising on the driving experience expected from a 3 Series.
about.boldParagraph: The 330e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
